😈 Welcome to Super Villain Tycoon! The ultimate tycoon building and fighting game! Construct your tycoon, unlock powerful abilities, and become stronger with every rebirth. Face off against powerful bosses, collect exclusive skins, and defeat enemies with your unique abilities. 

🎁 CODE at 5k LIKES 

💵 Join the group for a special in-game tag and cash awards! 
https://www.roblox.com/communities/3020631/Super-Heroes#!/about 

🎮 Controls 
Tab – Inventory 
Q – Dash 
E – Interact 
G – Emote 
F – Ultimate 

👍 If you enjoyed the game, don't forget to leave a like!
